_comment: Engine-shaped limits for the deterministic simulation. Pool capacities are hard ceilings: the sim never grows an array at runtime, so these must exceed the worst case any wave file can produce - and Database refuses to load a wave that would breach one rather than letting spawns vanish. max_enemies went 1280 -> 2048 when head-count started scaling with the deployment limit; the heaviest authored wave is 1,621 drones. max_projectiles went 2560 -> 8192 for the same reason at the other end: 144 turrets put far more shots in the air than 60 did. Both loops are O(pool) per tick regardless of how much is alive, so these are a real cost and not free headroom.
